subject: Sorry about the bin mix-up
text:
Hi there,

I am sorry. The note earlier was wrong. I should not have sounded so firm. That was my fault. I reread my message. It was sharp. I did not mean it that way. The trash bin was confusing. I thought I was being clear. I forgot you had asked last week. I jumped ahead. You had a fair point. The bin on the side looks fine now. I was annoyed by the bag sticking out. That was silly. I made it a bigger deal than needed. You did not want to cause trouble. I understand. We both wanted a tidy path. I should have texted you first. Or asked in passing. I should not have assumed. I’m glad we cleared the air. I am not upset. I hope you are not upset. Please don’t take it personally. I’m usually fine. That week was busy. The work shift threw me off. I lost my cool. I should apologize again. It will not happen. If I see you on Sunday, I will smile. If you want to talk, I am around. The bin stays in the same spot. The bags can wait until morning. We can both be calm. Thanks for not reacting badly. I appreciate it. The street will be quiet. After that, everything feels easy. No hard feelings from me. If I seem tense, ignore it. I’ll bring a simple wave next time.
